data.reportText: Delta Air Lines, Inc. Common Stock is expected* to report earnings on  10/09/2026 before market open.  The report will be for the fiscal Quarter ending Sep 2026.  According to Zacks Investment Research, based on  6 analysts'  forecasts, the consensus EPS forecast for the quarter is $2.03.  The reported EPS for the same quarter last year was $1.71.
